name: 侠客行（老版/金庸群侠传）
english_name: Ode to Gallantry (Old Edition / Heroes of Jin Yong)
english_description: Extracted from a mislabeled ".rar" that is actually a POSIX tar archive with "../"-prefixed member paths. The archive also contains an unused adm/obj/master.lpc that happens to share identical bytes with the jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 framework code, but the site actually boots from a different file, /adm/single/master, so this look-alike master was never really loaded. Its map resembles the jyqxc/jyqxc2 family (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, and more).
